theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapter_name: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
question_text: What must you be aware of when using navigation systems and road maps?

options.text: The contents may become outdated just a short time after purchase
Even up-to-date contents may differ from reality
All navigation systems can update themselves automatically

correct_answers.text: The contents may become outdated just a short time after purchase
Even up-to-date contents may differ from reality

comment: When using a navigation system, you should be aware that even current content can deviate from reality and content can become outdated shortly after purchase. There is no guarantee that the content is up to date despite automatic updating.

question_text: What must you be aware of when route planning abroad?

- applicable speed limits

correct_answers.text: - applicable conditions for inner city road use (a city toll for example)
- labelling requirements for driving in environment zones
- applicable speed limits

comment: Before driving, find out which regulations apply abroad.

question_text: What must you take into account when planning routes?

Possible traffic obstructions due to building sites

correct_answers.text: Possible traffic obstructions due to holiday traffic in different federal states
Possible traffic obstructions due to building sites

comment: For your route planning please pay attention to possible traffic delays due to road works and possible traffic delays by holiday traffic in different provinces.

80 km/h
40 km/h

Stops for fuel and rests
Animal protection regulations for transports

correct_answers.text: Checks and maintenance of the load
Stops for fuel and rests
Animal protection regulations for transports

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles

question_text: You want to establish a route plan to drive from Frankfurt (Oder) to Kiel. You have to exchange loads at different intermediate stops. Which information is necessary to plan your route in terms of roads and time?

options.text: Starting point, destination, sequence of intermediate stops, scheduled loading times and travel interruptions
Location, destination, intermediate stops, maximum speed
Location, destination, driving speed

correct_answers.text: Starting point, destination, sequence of intermediate stops, scheduled loading times and travel interruptions

comment: In your directions from Frankfurt (Oder) to Kiel, with different intermediate stations, because of charge exchange, the following information should be provided: starting point, destination, order of the waypoints, planned charging periods and breaks.

question_text: What must you be aware of when using a navigation system in the vehicle?

The navigation device should not lie around in the car unattached

The navigation device should not lie around in the car unattached

question_text: What activities could pose a highly risky distraction while driving?

options.text: Entering an address in the sat-nav
Writing a text message
Using the telephone even through a hands-free unit

correct_answers.text: Entering an address in the sat-nav
Writing a text message
Using the telephone even through a hands-free unit

comment: All three activities distract the car driver from traffic during the journey. The car driver might not be able to recognize dangerous situation in time.

- is intended to avoid impairments to the driving style
